method: Fresh Lean process per file/version/repetition, with dependencies already built. Files executed sequentially, before/after interleaved per file; reverse file and version order in the second repetition. Elab.async false in both instrumented snapshots. IO.monoNanosNow timestamps inside tactics; record both end times from the same timestamp, before the continuation proof body. All 660 measurements have successful enclosing proof compilation. Timer logging and subsequent proof reasoning are excluded.
complete_macro_boundary: Start immediately before the expansion of provePuddleValid; stop after its semantic normalization, before caller continuation. Includes try unfoldPuddleBuilder, constructor, provePuddleSupported, cbv, native_decide, and semantic normalization. Caller unfolding/cbv preceding provePuddleValid, imports, helper lemmas, continuation, and final theorem checking are excluded.
simplification_boundary: Start after the three structural Valid fields are proved; stop after simpPuddleSemantics (ordinary) or simpPuddleSemanticsSym (symbolic). Symbolic time includes unfoldPuddleSemanticsForSym, any ordinary simpPuddleCore [] preprocessing for native metadata, sym setup, and named puddleSemantics simplification. No caller continuation is timed.
before_version: All 110 call sites use ordinary provePuddleValid, as in the prior whole-file baseline.
after_version: All 110 call sites use provePuddleValid sym =>, as in the prior whole-file updated snapshot.

module
public meta import Lean
public section
open Lean Elab Tactic
meta initialize benchStarts : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap String Nat) ← IO.mkRef {}
elab "bench_start" key:str : tactic => do
  let t ← IO.monoNanosNow
  benchStarts.modify fun m => m.insert key.getString t
elab "bench_finish" key:str : tactic => do
  let t ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let starts ← benchStarts.get
  let some t0 := starts[key.getString ++ ":macro"]? | throwError "missing macro start"
  let some ts := starts[key.getString ++ ":simplify"]? | throwError "missing simplify start"
  logInfo m!"PUDDLE_BENCH|{key.getString}|{t - t0}|{t - ts}"
end

import json,re
root=Path('/Users/fehr/prog/veir')
work=Path('/private/tmp/veir-sym-validity-bench')
helper='''module
public meta import Lean
public section
open Lean Elab Tactic
meta initialize benchStarts : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap String Nat) ← IO.mkRef {}
elab "bench_start" key:str : tactic => do

  let some ts := starts[key.getString ++ ":simplify"]? | throwError "missing simplify start"
  logInfo m!"PUDDLE_BENCH|{key.getString}|{t - t0}|{t - ts}"
end
'''
(root/'.lake/build/lib/lean/VeirBenchTimers.lean').write_text(helper)
(work/'VeirBenchTimers.lean').write_text(helper)
manifest=[]
for version in ['before','after']:
    dest=work/('isolated_'+version)
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for filename in json.loads((work/'files.json').read_text()):
        lines=(work/version/filename).read_text().splitlines()
        lines.insert(1,'public meta import VeirBenchTimers')
        last_import=max(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r'(public (meta )?)?import ',l))
        lines.insert(last_import+1,'set_option Elab.async false')
        out=[]
        decl=None
        for line in lines:
            found=re.search(r'\btheorem\s+(\S+)',line)
            if found: decl=found.group(1)
            if re.fullmatch(r'\s*provePuddleValid(?: sym =>)?',line):
                assert decl
                indent=line[:len(line)-len(line.lstrip())]
                key=filename+':'+decl
                expansion=[f'bench_start "{key}:macro"','try unfoldPuddleBuilder','constructor','· provePuddleSupported','· cbv','· native_decide',f'bench_start "{key}:simplify"']
                if version=='before':
                    expansion+=['simpPuddleSemantics',f'bench_finish "{key}"']
                else:
                    expansion+=['simpPuddleSemanticsSym =>',f'  bench_finish "{key}"']
                out.extend(indent+l for l in expansion)
                manifest.append(dict(version=version,file=filename,theorem=decl))
            else: out.append(line)
        (dest/filename).write_text('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
(work/'isolated_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print('instrumented',len(manifest),'calls')
instrumentation.runner:
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,time,sys,hashlib
root=Path('/Users/fehr/prog/veir')
work=Path('/private/tmp/veir-sym-validity-bench')
files=json.loads((work/'files.json').read_text())
manifest=json.loads((work/'isolated_manifest.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for trial in range(3):
    order=files if trial%2==0 else list(reversed(files))
    versions=['before','after'] if trial%2==0 else ['after','before']
    for filename in order:
        for version in versions:
            source=work/('isolated_'+version)/filename
            start=time.perf_counter()
            proc=subprocess.run(['lake','env','lean','--tstack=400000',str(source)],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
            (work/f'isolated_{version}_{trial}_{filename}.log').write_text(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)
            data=re.findall(r'PUDDLE_BENCH\|([^|\n]+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)',proc.stdout)
            expected=[r for r in manifest if r['version']==version and r['file']==filename]
            if proc.returncode or len(data)!=len(expected):
                print(proc.stdout,proc.stderr,flush=True)
                raise SystemExit(f'{version} {filename}: return {proc.returncode}, expected {len(expected)} rows, got {len(data)}')
            for key,macro_ns,simplify_ns in data:
                rows.append(dict(trial=trial,version=version,file=filename,theorem=key.split(':',1)[1],macro_ns=int(macro_ns),simplify_ns=int(simplify_ns)))
            (work/'isolated_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(f'trial {trial+1} {version:6s} {filename}: {len(data)} measurements; macro {sum(int(x[1]) for x in data)/1e9:.3f}s simplify {sum(int(x[2]) for x in data)/1e9:.3f}s (process {elapsed:.1f}s)',flush=True)
print('COMPLETE',len(rows),flush=True)

runtime_variation_note: Absolute times increased across the three repetitions. Paired simplification speedups were 2.9916x, 3.2575x, and 2.9860x. Medians and all raw samples are retained; avoid interpreting the printed nanoseconds as measurement accuracy.

Original semantic continuation remains and every proof compiles. add64 is the first native_decide in the file, add32 is subsequent.

theorem CanInterpretTo.refines_int_result {op : OpCode} {p : propertiesOf op}
    {types : Array TypeAttr} {args : Array RuntimeValue} {w : Nat}
    {isUB : Bool} {value target : Data.LLVM.Int w}
    (hsource : CanInterpretTo op p types args
      (if isUB then .ub none else .ok #[.int w value]))
    (hvalue : value ⊒ target) :
    ∃ source, CanInterpretTo op p types args source ∧
      Interp.isRefinedBy RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy source (.ok #[.int w target]) := by
  refine ⟨_, hsource, ?_⟩
  cases isUB
  · simpa [Interp.isRefinedBy, RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons,
      RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy] using hvalue
  · simp [Interp.isRefinedBy]

end Puddle.CTree

theorem add64_pattern_valid : Puddle.CTree.Pattern.Valid add64_pattern := by
  unfold add64_pattern lowerBinary
  timePuddleStep "add64:builder" => try unfoldPuddleBuilder
  timePuddleStep "add64:constructor" => constructor
  · timePuddleStep "add64:supported" => provePuddleSupported
  · timePuddleStep "add64:root" => cbv
  · timePuddleStep "add64:wellFormed" => native_decide
  simpPuddleSemanticsSym =>
    rintro _ ty rfl hwidth
    simp only [RuntimeValue.Conforms.integerType, forall_exists_index, forall_eq_apply_imp_iff]
    intro x y p
    cases ty with | mk bw sign =>
      dsimp at hwidth
      subst bw
      cases x <;> cases y <;>
        simp [RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, Interp.isRefinedBy, RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy]
      all_goals simp [Id.run, pure, Pure.pure, Data.LLVM.Int.add, isRefinedBy, RISCV.Reg.toInt,
        Data.RISCV.add, RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy]
      all_goals
        intros
        subst_vars
        try simp [RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy, isRefinedBy]
      all_goals grind only [isRefinedBy]

theorem add32_pattern_valid : Puddle.CTree.Pattern.Valid add32_pattern := by
  unfold add32_pattern lowerBinary
  timePuddleStep "add32:builder" => try unfoldPuddleBuilder
  timePuddleStep "add32:constructor" => constructor
  · timePuddleStep "add32:supported" => provePuddleSupported
  · timePuddleStep "add32:root" => cbv
  · timePuddleStep "add32:wellFormed" => native_decide
  simpPuddleSemanticsSym =>
    rintro _ ty rfl hwidth
    simp only [RuntimeValue.Conforms.integerType, forall_exists_index, forall_eq_apply_imp_iff]
    intro x y p
    cases ty with | mk bw sign =>
      dsimp at hwidth
      subst bw
      have hplain := Data.RISCV.addw_refinement (x := x) (y := y)
      cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, Interp.isRefinedBy,
        RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy]
      all_goals simp [Id.run, pure, Pure.pure, Data.LLVM.Int.add, isRefinedBy, RISCV.Reg.toInt, Data.RISCV.addw,
        RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy, LLVM.Int.toReg] at hplain ⊢
      all_goals
        intros
        subst_vars
        try simp [hplain, RuntimeValue.arrayIsRefinedBy_cons, RuntimeValue.isRefinedBy, isRefinedBy]
      all_goals grind only [isRefinedBy]
